Most countable nouns add -s directly: books, cats|Those ending in s/x/ch/sh add -es: boxes, buses, watches, classes|Consonant letter + y: change y to i and add -es: cities, babies|Most ending in o add -s, but potatoes and tomatoes add -es|Irregular plurals need memorizing: man-men, child-children
There are two boxes under the bed.
There are two box under the bed.|There are two boxs under the bed.|There are two boxies under the bed.|There are two boxes under the bed.
